subject: Re: Implementation questionnaire — traffic diversion & schema transition checklist
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@pioneercap.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Lee <michael.lee@pioneercap.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation questionnaire for RFP - Pioneer Capital

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our RFP pack we need a detailed implementation/migration plan that covers timelines, integration touchpoints, traffic diversion strategy, canary/rollback gates, and any schema or contract changes that Pioneer should expect during cutover.

I've attached the RFP worksheet sections we need completed. High-level asks:
- A step-by-step migration timeline for a two-week pilot -> phased cutover to prod.
- Integration checklist for our ingestion and policy enforcement layers (network, auth, telemetry).
- Canary gating criteria and automated rollback triggers.
- Data validation and read-after-write guarantees we can expect while switching traffic.

Can you return a completed matrix by EOD next Thursday (4/1)? Also flag any pre-migration dependencies (e.g., VPC peering, outbound firewall rules, certificate exchange).

Attachments: pioneer_rfp_implementation_matrix_v1.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks,
Emily Zhao
Senior Cloud Architect
Pioneer Capital
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@pioneercap.com>
Cc: Michael Lee <michael.lee@pioneercap.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation questionnaire for RFP - Pioneer Capital

Emily —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is our completed implementation matrix and a short network diagram showing required connectivity patterns. Highlights up front:

- Pilot window (non-prod): 2 business days of live traffic, incremental ramp to 5% traffic.
- Phase 1 cutover (stage): 1 week, 5 — 25% traffic with KV-prefix caching warmup.
- Phase 2 (prod): gradual 25% -> 100% over 3 days with hourly health checks and auto-fallback to model-variant X-small if latency > 500ms for >5m.
- Canary gates: token-level lat/quality regression thresholds, error rate threshold (>=1.5% 5m rolling -> rollback), tail-latency SLOs.

Pre-reqs we flagged in the matrix: VPC peering with our private control plane, ip allowlist for inference pools, and one service account per Pioneer environment for KMS access.

Attachments: pioneer_rfp_implementation_matrix_v1.xlsx, network_diagram_v2.pdf

We left some optional items blank where we need Pioneer input — I put those notes inline in the matrix. If helpful, we can run a 30-minute alignment call Tuesday to finalize.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Implementation questionnaire for RFP - Pioneer Capital

Tessa/Team — quick thoughts after reviewing the matrix:

- Canary duration: recommend 12-hour soft-gates (monitor quality + latency) before promoting to next ramp step; longer for night-window traffic.
- Data validation: include a shadow-compare job for the first 48 hours post-cutover to ensure inference parity on 99 sample requests/hour.
- Rollback automation: we can surface an endpoint that Pioneer can call to switch routing back to their previous endpoint, but we should also expose automatic fallback in our router based on the configured thresholds.

Questions for Tessa: do we have capacity headroom calculations for the 5%->25% ramp given their token distribution? I can run numbers if you share their sample traffic distribution.

—Rishi
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Implementation questionnaire for RFP - Pioneer Capital

Rishi — thanks. I added a new sheet in the matrix with a conservative capacity plan and token-bucket assumptions for the pilot ramp (see rows 40–58). Short version: with our default batching config and kv-prefix caching enabled, 5% of their projected peak qps should be within a single dedup/gpu pool without needing extra nodes for 48 hours. For 25% we recommend provisioning +20% burst headroom.

Also: Evelyn, can you confirm monitoring hooks — specifically that we expose per-route token-level latency and the sample payload capture for the shadow compare job? We should list the retention period (30 days) and whether Pioneer wants payload redaction.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_20270401.docx

Tessa
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Implementation questionnaire for RFP - Pioneer Capital

Confirming monitoring hooks:

- Per-route metrics: token_latency_ms (p50/p95/p99), tokens_generated, errors, model_variant.
- Sample capture: configurable sampling at 0.1% by default, adjustable to 1% for pilot. Storage: encrypted, 30d retention. Redaction: we support field-level redaction; Pioneer needs to specify fields to redact before we ingest.
- Alerts: we will expose Alert rules that Pioneer can subscribe to (Slack/email) and an incident webhook.

I'll add example alert thresholds to the mutual action plan and ensure the shadow-compare job runs on a separate low-priority pool to avoid interference.

—Evelyn
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@pioneercap.com>, Michael Lee <michael.lee@pioneercap.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation questionnaire for RFP - Pioneer Capital

Hi Emily / Michael —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the RFP worksheet. Attached are the completed items we promised:
- implementation matrix (rows include timeline, responsibilities, pre-reqs)
- network diagram (required connectivity + sample firewall rules)
- mutual action plan with canary gates, rollback triggers, and monitoring hooks.

Summary of the agreed migration approach:
1) Pilot (non-prod): 2 business days, 5% production-like traffic. Shadow-compare enabled at 1% sample rate.
2) Stage ramp: 1 week, 5% -> 25% with 12-hour soft gates and automated rollback on error-rate >=1.5% (5m rolling).
3) Prod cutover: 3 days, 25% -> 100% with hourly health checks and final acceptance window requiring p95 latency <= 450ms for 3 consecutive hours.

Pre-reqs for Pioneer: VPC peering, static egress IP allowlisting for our pools, service account for KMS.

Next steps: please confirm the firewall/contact window for the peering work and sign the mutual_action_plan_20270401.docx. If you want, we can do a 30-minute dry-run on staging next Tuesday (4/5) to exercise the rollback path.

Attachments: pioneer_rfp_implementation_matrix_v1.xlsx, network_diagram_v2.pdf, mutual_action_plan_20270401.docx

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Michael Lee <michael.lee@pioneercap.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@pioneercap.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Apr 2027 16:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation questionnaire for RFP - Pioneer Capital

Tessa — thanks for the thorough response and the attachments. Quick questions:
- For the shadow-compare job, can you provide a short template of the report we should expect (fields compared, delta thresholds)?
- For rollback automation: can Pioneer trigger both the manual and automated rollback? We want an ability to force-failover aside from the auto gates.

We'll review and aim to sign the mutual action plan by Monday. Dry-run on 4/5 works for us; Emily will coordinate internal availability.

—Michael
